title: CLI-Gym
input: Healthy SWE-smith repository images and upstream destruction settings.
native_output: Older Terminal-Bench task layout, Docker/Compose configuration and selected test runners.

conversion.approach: Translate the old task layout and reward entry point while preserving the original grading behavior.

deviations: GPT-4o replaces upstream Qwen default; original prompts and agent loop retained
Bounded to 30 inversion episodes and 4096 output tokens
Selected configuration-file damage after preserving a proposal for 50 parallel 1GB writes without executing it
Native pytest parser and empty-result behavior preserved; removed learner git metadata and disabled internet
known_limitations: The assembly path lacks our desired restoration oracle and may retain broken-runner cases. Audit these explicitly instead of changing upstream acceptance.

why_this_order: Reuse healthy repository images from the SWE-smith stage and reproduce environment inversion.
